name: virtx
description: Run tasks in Linux microVMs from Python, Node.js or Rust, with snapshots and volumes for what should outlive them.

interface.shortDescription: Linux microVMs from your own code
interface.longDescription: virtx runs tasks in Linux microVMs from Python, Node.js or Rust, with no Docker and no daemon to install. A sandbox boots from an image you build or pull, runs commands in it, and is gone when you remove it; what should outlive it is kept in a snapshot or a volume, and remote stores such as Notion or Google Drive can be mounted inside a volume, read-only. The GPU reaches into the VM through Vulkan, so heavy work such as deep learning runs there too.
capabilities: Build or pull an image, and boot Linux microVMs from it
Run commands in it and read their output, from Python, Node.js or Rust
Keep work in snapshots and volumes, and read their files without a VM
Cut the network, or give the VM a GPU, CPUs and memory
Reach a service in the VM through a forwarded port
Start a local server with one call, or connect to your own; no Docker
